title: Unfair trade practices.
bodyText: A violation of this chapter shall be considered an unfair trade practice pursuant to section 480-2 and subject to the penalties under chapter 480.
bodyHtml: [§431C-51]  Unfair trade practices.  A violation of this chapter shall be considered an unfair trade practice pursuant to section 480-2 and subject to the penalties under chapter 480. [L 2012, c 256, pt of §1]
